visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman are standing side-by-side in front of a vibrant, textured red wall that suggests a traditional Chinese historical or temple setting. They are dressed in ornate red Xiuhe fu wedding garments featuring elaborate gold-threaded patterns of dragons and phoenixes. The man wears a large, decorative red silk rosette over his chest. Both are smiling warmly directly at the camera, their hands held close together. (2) The woman brings her hands to the center and a white scroll with dark wooden rollers appears in a flash of light. She unrolls the scroll vertically to reveal large, black Chinese calligraphy characters that represent their wedding date. The man turns his head slightly toward her, his smile widening into a joyful laugh, while the background wall shows soft, natural shadows from trees. (3) As the couple continues to laugh and hold the scroll together, white digital text overlays appear in the upper half of the frame, clearly stating the date and an invitation message in a clean sans-serif font. They maintain their joyful expressions, creating a celebratory atmosphere. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of their traditional silk costumes against the solid red backdrop.
